summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.33/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.33 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 20, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest in WPR's 8 months of tracking. AAA figures put the statewide average 28¢ lower than a week ago, 72¢ lower than a month ago, and 68¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.07) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.79).
